blurb:
The Surf Bus is the original North Shore Activities Tour, created & run by long-time surfer residents, and since we're North Shore locals, you can rest assure to get the best experience with us!

Our tour gives you more time out off the bus having fun than any other tour company!

You will have free time to enjoy the beaches, shops and eateries around the North Shore, including the tips and expertise from our local guide!

Snorkels, Bicycles, Kayaks & Standup paddle boards are available for rent and Hawaiian green sea turtles are frequently seen on shore.

Freedom to do your own thing! That's us!
Since 2007!
